channel.title: NorthEast News
channel.description: Clear, fast reporting for New Hampshire and New England.

item.title: Manchester’s Merci boxcar prepares for annual commemoration
item.description: The New Hampshire car from France’s postwar Merci Train will open for tours during a September 27 ceremony on Reed Street.

item.title: Manchester crash seriously injures driver and juvenile passenger

item.title: Massachusetts adult-use cannabis sales pass Wed, 09 Sep 2026 18:46:00 GMT0 billion
item.description: The state’s licensed recreational market crossed the milestone on September 5, nearly eight years after the first stores opened.

item.title: New England Coffee Cafe sets September 14 reopening in Malden
item.description: The Charles Street shop has been closed since a May vehicle crash damaged the building and hospitalized two people.

item.title: Small plane overshoots Richmond runway; two occupants uninjured
item.description: A Piper Cub came to rest nose-down on Heaton Orchard Road after an attempted landing late Wednesday morning.

item.title: Providence poll-worker callouts cause early voting delays
item.description: Election officials reassigned staff after several polling places opened with fewer workers than expected Wednesday morning.

item.title: Norway’s prime minister says drone nearly hit Zelenskiy’s plane
item.description: Jonas Gahr Stoere said the incident occurred Tuesday as Ukraine’s president traveled to Oslo, but gave few details.

item.title: Apple unveils Wed, 09 Sep 2026 18:46:00 GMT,999 foldable iPhone Duo
item.description: The company’s first folding phone opens to a 7.6-inch display and leads its first major product event under CEO John Ternus.

item.title: India fraud office recommends detailed investigation of Xiaomi
item.description: The recommendation concerns alleged investment-rule and ownership irregularities, but the government has not approved a formal probe.

item.title: U.S. Treasury triples size of long-dated bond buyback

item.title: Boston Legacy supporters build an identity around the NWSL newcomer
item.description: An independent supporters group has supplied chants, drums and community input through the expansion club’s nomadic first season.

item.title: Elena Rybakina reaches U.S. Open semifinals and secures No. 1 ranking
item.description: The second seed rallied past Zheng Qinwen in three sets and will rise to the top of the women’s rankings after the tournament.

item.title: Nottingham approves 12-month moratorium on data centers

item.title: New Hampshire senators plan statewide Imagination Library bill
item.description: A bipartisan proposal would make free monthly books available to families with children from birth through age five across New Hampshire.

item.title: Nearly 2,000 Boston Medical Center nurses vote on strike authorization
item.description: The two-day union vote follows months of contract talks, but approval would not itself schedule a walkout.

item.title: Harvard adds first undergraduate-specific hazing policy
item.description: The new handbook language applies on and off campus and can hold students responsible for facilitating or silently allowing hazing.

item.title: Rhode Island primary turnout reaches 61,488 by 9 a.m.
item.description: Early voting helped lift the morning total as polling places opened statewide for Rhode Island’s September 9 primary.

item.title: Girls flag football becomes Rhode Island’s newest varsity sport

item.title: Twenty states and D.C. sue over weakened endangered-species rules

item.title: UK police widen criminal probe into Reform UK funding allegations

item.title: Researchers trace OpenAI agent communications across more websites

item.title: Tencent-backed Enflame sets Friday debut after $912 million IPO
item.description: The Chinese AI-chip designer raised 6.12 billion yuan ahead of a Shanghai STAR Market listing.

item.title: Most economists expect Fed to hold rates through 2026, Reuters poll finds
item.description: Expectations for a near-term increase have grown, but a majority of surveyed economists still forecast no change for the rest of the year.

item.title: Baker Hughes raises 2026 forecasts after Chart acquisition

item.title: Patriots open 2026 season in Super Bowl rematch with Seahawks

item.title: Criminal charges expected after Bow spa trafficking investigation

item.title: Wellesley expands tuition-free threshold to $200,000 for fall 2027

item.title: More than 17,000 URI students begin fall classes

item.title: URI surf-therapy study recruits youth with visual impairments
item.description: The free five-week pilot will examine physical skills and perceived self-competence in participants ages 5 to 17.

item.title: At least 14 killed in explosion at weapons depot in Syria’s Idlib
item.description: State television reported 11 others injured near Sarmada as officials had not yet disclosed a cause.

item.title: One dead as Turkey battles wildfires in southern provinces
item.description: Crews are still fighting active fires in parts of Antalya and Adana while other outbreaks are mostly under control.

item.title: Analog Devices to buy Alif Semiconductor for Wed, 09 Sep 2026 13:41:00 GMT.35 billion
item.description: The cash acquisition is intended to combine Analog Devices’ sensing portfolio with Alif’s edge-AI processors.

item.title: EU proposes common framework for tighter short-term rental rules

item.title: India lifts most of trading ban on JPMorgan unit, sources say
item.description: Copthall Mauritius may resume trading but remains excluded from closing auctions while an investigation continues.

item.title: Starbucks sales recover while turnaround costs squeeze margins

item.title: Kimi Raikkonen’s 11-year-old son joins Red Bull development program

item.title: French Alps 2030 organizing chief expected to leave, source says

item.title: Concord garage lights cast glowing rectangle into night sky

item.title: Showers and 35 mph gusts forecast for Manchester tonight

item.title: Watertown opens $219 million net-zero high school

item.title: Holyoke ticket wins record $29.71 million Megabucks jackpot

item.title: Tiverton conservation deal links 27 acres to Pocasset Ridge

item.title: Rhode Island keeps West Nile risk high after Providence detection
item.description: Mosquitoes collected August 24 tested positive for West Nile virus, while other samples were negative for several monitored diseases.

item.title: Bangladesh measles outbreak nears 1,000 deaths

item.title: Heavy rain triggers landslide at Mount Fuji access point

item.title: U.S. Bancorp tests dollar-backed stablecoin in cross-border transfer

item.title: Cegid and Silae plan €10 billion software merger

item.title: U.S. 30-year mortgage rate reaches 14-month high

item.title: Patriots reportedly give Christian Gonzalez four-year, Wed, 09 Sep 2026 12:43:00 GMT35 million extension

item.title: Lionel Messi reaches agreement to buy Spanish club Eldense

item.title: New Hampshire regular gas averages $4.19 as yearly increase tops a dollar

item.title: Massachusetts RMV will draw 2026 low-number plates Wednesday afternoon

item.title: Blue Envelope program expands statewide support for autistic drivers

item.title: Four Democrats compete to succeed Rhode Island Attorney General Peter Neronha

item.title: Small Craft Advisory starts Wednesday evening on Rhode Island Sound

item.title: Germany says Leipzig airport drone attack was prepared in Russia

item.title: Two seriously injured in explosion at Swiss hydroelectric plant
item.description: Police, firefighters and emergency crews responded in Piotta as investigators worked to determine the cause of the workplace accident.

item.title: Suno launches licensed AI music models with Warner Music and BMG
item.description: The v6 suite includes paid flagship and exploratory models plus a free mini version, with artist participation described as opt-in.

item.description: The Australian operator plans convertible notes to fund expansion while projecting sharply higher capital spending for fiscal 2027.

item.title: Wall Street futures hold near flat as oil shock tests risk appetite

item.description: New England enters an 8 p.m. match at Citi Field seeking points in its third consecutive road game.

item.title: American Charlotte Rose leads women’s ILCA 6 world championship

item.description: The state’s 2026 total already exceeds the recent annual average, and health officials are urging residents to avoid contact with wildlife.

item.title: Japan manufacturer sentiment reaches nearly five-year high

item.title: Iran says it captured U.S. underwater drone near Strait of Hormuz

item.description: The autonomous coding-agent company says its run-rate revenue has climbed to nearly $900 million since a May financing.

item.title: Google redesigns European search results to comply with DMA
item.description: The company is giving comparison services more prominence after an EU fine, while removing some real-time details from result carousels.

item.title: Adani Airports to raise about $1 billion from investor group

item.title: LIV Golf files for Chapter 11 with more than $500 million in debt
item.description: The league is seeking a court-supervised restructuring in New Jersey after Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund ended financial support.

item.title: East Providence grower cultivates hundreds of pawpaw trees
item.description: Joe Barros has spent 15 years building a backyard collection of North America’s largest native fruit and inviting neighbors to try it.

item.title: Aaron Judge returns to Yankees lineup after 84-game absence
item.description: The New York captain started in right field Tuesday after recovering from a stress fracture in his right first rib.

item.title: New Hampshire primary voters describe distrust and ambivalence

item.title: Mount Washington tribute will shine twin beams for four nights
item.description: The Honor Summit remembrance begins Wednesday, with organizers shortening nightly hours after consulting wildlife specialists.

item.title: Chicopee electric dirt-bike rider faces charges after crash

item.title: Police say Jeep fled Chicopee stop before striking Agawam ambulance
item.description: A new police account links the weekend Springfield crash to an earlier traffic stop; two paramedics suffered minor injuries.

item.title: Peach Cobbler Factory opens first New England shop in Providence
item.description: The Southern-dessert chain has opened near Federal Hill with cobblers, banana pudding, cinnamon rolls and late-night weekend hours.

item.title: Route 146 wrong-way crash suspect arraigned on DUI charges

item.title: Iran launches missiles toward U.S. targets in Jordan after tanker strikes
item.description: Jordan said it intercepted most of 18 ballistic missiles as the latest U.S.-Iran exchange raised fears of a wider regional conflict.

item.title: Hurricane Lowell knocks out power across Kauai and damages coast
item.description: Nearly all of the island utility’s members lost electricity as destructive winds, heavy rain and large waves battered western Hawaii.

item.title: OpenAI expands AI tools into chip design and specialized industries
item.description: The company says its models helped move an internal chip project to tape-out in nine months as it pursues enterprise work beyond general chat.

item.title: FCC proposes opening more spectrum for space-based broadband
item.description: The agency plans a September 30 vote on changes covering the 12 GHz and 42 GHz bands, satellite links and ultra-wideband devices.

item.title: Holtec Nuclear seeks up to $10.2 billion valuation in U.S. IPO

item.title: EverBank and WaFd agree to $3.9 billion reverse merger

item.title: Patriots rule out TreVeyon Henderson for season opener in Seattle

item.title: Plymouth volunteers help 94-year-old return to White Horse Beach
item.description: Community members helped Alison Blomgren reach the sand after her daughter asked for assistance fulfilling a birthday wish.

item.title: Anthony DiLorenzo wins GOP primary for open New Hampshire House seat

item.description: The incumbent Democrat and Republican challenger will meet again after facing each other in the district’s 2024 general election.

item.title: Johnston parents rally as school-bus delays and long rides continue
item.description: Families say communication and routing problems persist weeks after the district began working with a new transportation provider.

item.title: Worker injured in Burrillville construction-site roof collapse

item.title: Tamarack and Headwater agree to $7.25 billion oil merger
item.description: The all-stock transaction would create the largest publicly traded producer focused on Alberta’s Clearwater Formation.

item.title: Bruins sign Fraser Minten to seven-year, $50.4 million extension
item.description: The 22-year-old center is under contract through 2033-34 after producing 35 points in his first full season with Boston.

item.title: Boston fashion designer and philanthropist Yolanda Celucci dies at 91

item.title: Chris Pappas wins New Hampshire Democratic Senate primary

item.description: The former senator defeated Scott Brown and will face Democrat Chris Pappas for New Hampshire’s open U.S. Senate seat.

item.title: Springfield schools stay closed as severe cyberattack response continues
item.description: The district will remain shut Wednesday as officials work without access to student health, transportation and food-service systems.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy’s lawyer asks Trump for pardon after mistrial

item.title: Rhode Island primary sets record for early in-person voting

item.title: Juvenile charged with murder in Providence killing of Joseph Ramos

item.title: Ayotte and Warmington win New Hampshire governor primaries
item.description: The incumbent Republican governor and former Democratic Executive Councilor advance to the November general election.

item.title: U.S. says it destroyed five Iranian oil tankers after warship attacks

item.description: Officials say companies including DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and Alibaba used American model outputs at scale to accelerate their own systems.

item.description: The new assistant can work across connected services in the background, putting privacy and security controls at the center of its rollout.

item.title: GE Aerospace to buy castings supplier CPP for $11.75 billion

item.title: Chime agrees to buy Stride Bank for $590 million
item.description: The fintech company is seeking a national bank charter and more control over the infrastructure behind its accounts and lending expansion.

item.title: ‘Man in the Red Bandana’ Welles Crowther awarded Medal of Freedom
item.description: The Boston College graduate and volunteer firefighter was honored posthumously for helping people escape the World Trade Center on Sept. 11.

item.title: First ‘Remain’ trailer brings Rhode Island-shot thriller into view
item.description: M. Night Shyamalan’s supernatural romance, filmed around the Ocean State, pairs Jake Gyllenhaal and Phoebe Dynevor ahead of a February release.

item.title: 46,000 Boston students return as schools start new year

item.title: Massachusetts’ new heat-resilience role puts extreme heat on state agenda

item.description: Mayor Brett Smiley and state Rep. David Morales are offering competing answers to the city’s affordability crisis ahead of Wednesday’s Democratic primary.

item.title: Topsfield Fair warns vendors about scam emails

item.title: Stanley Cup coming to Stoughton High School Thursday

item.title: Qualcomm and Amazon deepen AI-chip ties in multibillion-dollar agreement

item.description: A request for up to 20 million additional gallons a day is prompting questions about which communities need the supply and what alternatives were considered.

item.title: New Hampshire school-ID voting rule gets first test at UNH

item.title: Neighbors and firefighters rescue 17-year-old dog in Dorchester
item.description: Milly, who is blind and deaf, wandered from her fenced yard before a neighborhood search brought her safely home about four hours later.
